title: Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA6 Collectables Box That Won't Clear Airport Security
description: Rockstar Games has announced a limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6 priced at £349, excluding the game, available for pre-order now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Announces £350 Goodtime State Vice City Collection for GTA6

As anticipation continues to build for the eventual release of Grand Theft Auto 6, Rockstar Games has revealed a brand new, highly exclusive merchandise drop for fans of the franchise. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the studio has announced the limited "Goodtime State Vice City" collection of goodies, tailored specifically for hardcore enthusiasts of the upcoming title.

However, the announcement has quickly become a talking point within the gaming community due to its steep price tag and unconventional offerings. The collection is priced at a staggering £349, positioning it firmly as a high-end luxury item for serious collectors. Notably, media reports confirm that this hefty price tag **does not include a copy of the game itself**, meaning buyers will need to purchase the software separately.

## Naughty Collectables That Might Raise Airport Eyebrows

Described in reports as a collection of "naughty" GTA 6 collectables, the package includes items with such a distinct and edgy theme that reviewers jokingly noted you definitely wouldn't be able to get them through airport security. This provocative design philosophy aligns seamlessly with the chaotic, satirical, and law-breaking spirit that the Grand Theft Auto series has embodied for decades.

While complete itemized details of the box are part of the ongoing rollout, the mere teasing of items too controversial for standard travel security has certainly spiked curiosity across the fan base.

## Pre-Orders Are Live Now

For those willing to open their wallets, the Goodtime State Vice City collection is currently available for pre-order. Given the premium £349 cost and the absence of the actual game disc or digital code, this release is clearly targeted at dedicated collectors rather than casual players.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar has never shied away from bold marketing and premium merchandise strategies. A £349 price point without the game is a massive ask, but the promise of items that wouldn't pass airport security leans heavily into the cheeky, rebellious identity of GTA. Fans should carefully weigh whether the novelty of these collectables justifies the luxury price before hitting the pre-order button.
